prompts.10: Edit target: first reference, the level 10 Waldwaechter tower sprite. Supporting style/size reference: second image contains the original levels 1/4/7. Produce ONLY the separate building base from the first image, no weapon, as a transparent-background pixel-art sprite. User likes this design but its tall parapets and giant corner merlons make the building too large. Make ONE targeted structural correction: flatten the entire top platform into a thin unobstructed firing deck with tiny low-profile corner caps, no high surrounding walls, no rising pillars above the deck, no crown/spikes. Delete the tall back corner turrets. Keep the deck back edge at the height of the original level 7, with short low edging. The weapon will later be composited on top separately. Retain the wooden front, blue chevron pennant, lower foundation, dark plum outlines, steel supports with modest reinforcement. Do not make a taller tower, wider footprint or extra storey. Preserve viewpoint (top-down 3/4 game sprite, frontal symmetric facade, no isometric rotation). Large readable pixel clusters on roughly a 64x116 logical grid, strict nearest-neighbour pixelart, clean flat palette, no blur, NO glow or drop shadow, real transparency. Render one base only centered with margin, no text or captions. The upper platform must look open and compact, not like a castle battlement. Body width and mount layout like the original level 7. This is a compact replacement base, not a new tower type.
